licence.scope: Level 2, NASA Science Data Portal licence, as applied to Cassini/ISS_NAC on NJM. Mars Pathfinder (IMP camera) is a NASA-led mission and the filter responses are calibration data; the statement is applied by analogy, since it says data 'marked with a restrictive notice or license' are excepted and no Pathfinder page was found to carry one. SVO's info.json is empty; the SVO records cite JGR 102, 3989, 1997 (bibcode 1997JGR...102.3989M, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1997JGR...102.3989M/); the paper's own licence (AGU/Wiley) was not read. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: NASA should be acknowledged as the source of the material.
